name: reygallery
title: reygallery
blurb: a fancy little museum wing for @rey-notnecessarily.bsky.social's art — self-portraits and image posts pulled live from their own repo, each hung with a title, year, and artist's statement.
why: It calls itself a museum wing in its own blurb. That's the whole bar.

name: reygiftshop
title: reygiftshop
blurb: the museum gift shop reygallery didn't know it needed: totes, mugs, posters, and pins printed with whatever @rey-notnecessarily.bsky.social has actually posted.
why: Every real museum has a gift shop on the way out. This is theirs.

name: apocrypha
title: apocrypha
blurb: the permanent collection: every account that has ever tagged the bot, exhumed and misattributed to real historical figures, hung with extremely dramatic museum-plaque styling.
why: Real portraits, fictional pairings, and it insists on being called "the permanent collection." Institution enough.

name: slopfair
title: The World Fair of Slop
blurb: a museum exhibition of default llm-generated web design — gradient heroes, trust badge walls, testimonial rotundas — each pavilion placarded like a real artifact.
why: It's a World's Fair. World's Fairs are just museums that travel.

name: receipts
title: receipts
blurb: every ask this bot has ever gotten, laid out and roasted — a hall of shame and a full build archive.
why: This museum's own critic keeps its collection in a wing of its own. Recursion, again.
